configurePresets.name: windows-msvc
configurePresets.description: Build PSOPT in Visual Studio with the MSVC toolchain; dependencies via vcpkg. Set VCPKG_ROOT, and provide ADOL-C via ADOLC_ROOT (built separately). See docs/BUILD_WINDOWS.md.

configurePresets.name: windows-intel
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x64 (MSVC C++ + Intel oneAPI: MKL + ifx Fortran)
configurePresets.description: MSVC builds PSOPT's C++; Intel oneMKL supplies BLAS/LAPACK (and MKL PARDISO as IPOPT's linear solver, ipopt_linear_solver=pardisomkl); Intel Fortran (ifx) builds the Fortran deps (MUMPS/IPOPT). Run configure from an 'Intel oneAPI command prompt' (after setvars.bat) so MKLROOT and ifx are on PATH.

configurePresets.name: windows-casadi-nofortran
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x64 (MSVC, CasADi backend — NO Fortran)
configurePresets.description: Pure-C++ NLP path: CasADi with a C++ solver (fatrop, or sqpmethod+qpOASES) instead of IPOPT/MUMPS, so NO Fortran compiler is needed. Still requires ADOL-C (C++, no Fortran). At run time set algorithm.nlp_method="CASADI" and casadi_solver="fatrop" (or "sqpmethod").

configurePresets.name: windows-superbuild
configurePresets.description: Build ALL dependencies from source (Eigen/ColPack/ADOL-C/METIS/MUMPS/IPOPT) via -DPSOPT_SUPERBUILD=ON using the MinGW-w64 GNU toolchain (gcc/g++/gfortran) under MSYS2. This is NOT MSVC: the autotools/make/Fortran superbuild needs a GNU/Unix environment. Run from an MSYS2 MINGW64 shell (pacman -S: gcc gcc-fortran cmake make autoconf automake libtool patch openblas gettext-devel pkgconf). Uses the 'MSYS Makefiles' generator, NOT Ninja: the autotools deps (autoreconf/./configure are shell scripts) must run through a Unix shell — Ninja on Windows dispatches recipe commands to cmd.exe, which cannot execute them ('autoreconf ... is not recognized'). MSYS2 make runs recipes via /bin/sh. superbuild.cmake is macOS-tuned; expect further Windows portability fixes. Experimental/untested.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-superbuild
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x64 (MSVC, from-source superbuild — CasADi, no Fortran)
configurePresets.description: One-command MSVC build: -DPSOPT_SUPERBUILD=ON builds Eigen (CMake), ADOL-C (via its Visual Studio solution / msbuild), and CasADi (CMake, WITH_IPOPT=OFF) from source, then PSOPT with PSOPT_WITH_IPOPT=OFF. Boost/OpenBLAS still come from vcpkg (VCPKG_ROOT; forwarded to the PSOPT sub-build). Run from a Developer PowerShell for VS 18. EXPERIMENTAL/UNTESTED — ADOL-C's .sln output paths and MSVC source portability will likely need iteration; this is the 'automate the manual appendix' path.
